description: Export every card of a deck (front, back, hint, tags) plus the deck's settings as JSON — for a backup, for converting the deck to another format for the user, or for copying it elsewhere. The same shape can be imported back with add_memo_cards or the web importer. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

name: export_memo_deck
